capabilities/oem-odm.intro_title: What Is the Difference Between OEM and ODM Plastic Bottle Manufacturing?
capabilities/oem-odm.intro_summary: The project route affects tooling, development cost, approval time and what information the buyer needs to provide.
intro_paragraphs: In a model-based OEM or private-label project, the buyer chooses an existing XUYI bottle model and asks about decorating or packing it for a brand. This may involve a logo, artwork, an available cap color, a straw option or a specific carton. Each choice is checked against the actual body and closure; a photograph alone cannot establish what is available.

In a deeper ODM project, the buyer requests design changes such as a new bottle profile, adjusted grip, new lid mechanism or modified capacity. This may need drawings, engineering review, tooling and physical prototypes. A request for a 'new design' is not the same as a guaranteed new mold: feasibility, tool ownership, intellectual property and cost must be agreed in writing.

XUYI operates its own manufacturing facility in Taizhou and may coordinate selected partner-made styles. Buyers should confirm which facility and process applies to the selected model. We focus exclusively on plastic drinkware in this catalog, not glass bottles or stainless-steel insulated tumblers.

capabilities/oem-odm.faq_title: OEM / ODM Plastic Water Bottle FAQs
capabilities/oem-odm.faq_summary: Direct answers to questions brands and wholesale importers ask before requesting a quotation.
faqs: Can I put my own logo on XUYI plastic water bottles?
Send the model code, vector logo, preferred placement, colors and quantity. We can review model-specific printing or labeling options and confirm feasibility in a quote.
What is the difference between OEM and ODM water bottles?
OEM commonly starts with an existing design and applies agreed branding or options. ODM may involve new product design, drawings, prototypes and tooling. The actual project scope must be agreed.
Is a new mold required for a customized water bottle?
Not always. Existing-model branding may avoid new structural tooling. A changed shape, capacity or closure can require mold evaluation and additional prototypes.
What is the minimum order quantity for private-label bottles?
There is no single verified MOQ across all models. It changes with stock status, printing method, color, packing and tooling, so provide your model and volume for confirmation.
Can you make BPA-free or food-contact-compliant bottles?

Do not infer compliance from appearance or a polymer name. Specify the exact model, body and lid materials, intended food-contact use and destination regulations; matching documentation must be reviewed before claims are made.
Can I review a sample before bulk production?
Sample availability, decoration proofs, fees, schedule and shipping are confirmed for the selected model. Bulk orders should be checked against an approved reference sample.
Do you offer design exclusivity or NDAs?
Discuss confidentiality and design/tooling ownership before sharing sensitive drawings. Any NDA, exclusivity or tooling rights require a specific agreement rather than an assumed website promise.

capabilities/oem-odm.cta_paragraph: Send the source model, intended use, order quantity, brand artwork and destination. We will prepare a model-specific discussion covering feasible custom options, samples and commercial terms.

manufacturing.answer: A reusable plastic water bottle project begins with the correct body, lid and material specification, followed by a production method suited to the model, component assembly, checks and packing. XUYI coordinates this process through its own Taizhou facility and selected partner production where applicable.

manufacturing.intro_title: A Realistic Plastic Bottle Workflow Starts With Components
manufacturing.intro_summary: Do not confuse plastic-bottle molding with stainless-steel vacuum flask manufacturing: the processes and inspection needs differ.
intro_paragraphs: Different plastic bottle designs use different body and cap materials, molding methods and closure mechanisms. Depending on the selected model, a hollow bottle body may involve a suitable blow-molding process, while caps, handles or other components may use injection molding. This is a description of common production methods, not a claim that every XUYI SKU uses the same equipment.

For each project, the product specification should identify the body, lid, straw, seals, grip components, nominal fill volume, dimensions and intended use. The factory route, material requirements, tooling and sampling approach can then be reviewed. If a model is sourced from a selected partner facility, responsibility for quality and finished-product approval should be clear.

Production descriptions become genuinely useful when they tell buyers what is checked and what documents to request. The source catalog provides bottle model references, but workshop images, equipment inventory, production rates and test reports will be published only after verification.

manufacturing.decision_title: Separate Process Description From Verified Evidence
decision_paragraphs: A sourcing page can explain how plastic bottle manufacturing works without pretending that a stock photograph is a workshop image. Ask for actual factory photos, a model-specific test report or a production sample when those are essential to supplier approval.

If your project needs child-use suitability, a new lid mechanism or specific temperature performance, turn that into an agreed technical test requirement rather than relying on general 'high quality' language.
manufacturing.faq_summary: Questions about components, tooling, samples and repeat-order consistency.
faqs: How are plastic water bottle bodies made?

The process depends on polymer, body geometry and tooling. Some hollow plastic bodies use suitable blow-molding methods, while lids and smaller parts often use injection molding. Confirm the actual process for the chosen model.
Does XUYI manufacture every catalog model in-house?
XUYI has its own manufacturing facility and may coordinate selected production partners for certain product styles. The supply route for the chosen SKU must be confirmed.
Do reusable bottles require separate lids and seals?
Many designs have distinct cap, drinking, gasket and carrying components. Their materials and fit should be checked separately rather than assuming the bottle body specification covers all parts.
Can I change a mold or bottle capacity?
Such requests require drawing review, manufacturing feasibility and potentially new tooling. Cost, ownership, timing and prototype approval depend on the design.
How do buyers approve a sample before mass production?
Compare the physical sample to a documented model and revision, including color, dimensions, lid function, print, carton and agreed verification tests. Record approval before production.
What documents should I request from a bottle factory?
A model-specific specification, component material information, any applicable test documents, sample approval record and agreed packing data are more useful than generic factory marketing claims.
Is there a fixed plastic bottle production lead time?
Not one that can be verified for every design. Production and sample timing depend on selected model, raw materials, order quantity, colors, tooling and approval changes.

quality-control.seo_title: Plastic Water Bottle Quality Control & Testing | XUYI
quality-control.description: Learn what to verify when sourcing plastic bottles: component materials, lid leak checks, sample approval, logo adhesion, inspection reports and destination standards.
quality-control.h1: Plastic Water Bottle Quality Control & Buyer Checks
quality-control.answer: Plastic bottle quality involves more than the appearance of the body. Buyers should verify the components, lid fit, drinking mechanism, capacity, printing, carton packing and any destination-market food-contact documentation. XUYI discusses inspection needs against the selected model and agreed specification, not a blanket certificate claim.
quality-control.image_alt: XUYI plastic water bottle designs with different lids and components used for quality planning
trust: Body, lid, straw, seals and accessories
Verify exact material and report coverage
quality-control.intro_title: What Should Be Inspected on a Reusable Plastic Water Bottle?
quality-control.intro_summary: Material suitability, closure function, appearance and packing need separate evidence; no generic promise can substitute for a model-specific check.
intro_paragraphs: For a plastic sports bottle or large water jug, buyers typically care about volume, lid fit, handling, leakage under defined conditions, surface condition and consistency between units. A kids bottle adds concerns about straw components, detachable accessories, cleaning and age-appropriate labeling. A shaker bottle can have additional closure, scale marking or mixing-component checks. Each design should have its own acceptance criteria.

Body and lid materials should not be treated as interchangeable. Catalog descriptions may list PP, PE, PC or other plastics for different parts. Material names alone do not prove BPA-free status, food-contact compliance or suitability for hot drinks. Any declaration or test report must match the exact product, components, intended use and destination market.

An effective inspection plan identifies what to check, when it is checked, how results are recorded and what happens if the sample does not meet the agreed specification. XUYI can discuss relevant sample and order checks with buyers; the website does not claim all listed tests, facilities, certificates or inspection methods are already available for every SKU.
quality-control.buyer_title: Four Risk Areas to Check Before Release
quality-control.buyer_summary: These priorities are practical guidance for an agreed quality plan, not claims that a particular laboratory test has already passed.
buyer_cards: Body and dimensions
Check height, diameter, nominal capacity, threads, body appearance and assembly fit against the model reference.
Cap, straw and seal
Review lid engagement, gasket seating, drinking mechanism, handle and leakage using an agreed sample and method.
Print and decoration
Confirm position, color appearance, legibility, adhesion expectations and cosmetic acceptance criteria.
Carton and shipment
Inspect product count, barcode or label placement, protective wrapping, carton markings and transit readiness.

Agree on inspection and test methods
Specify function checks, dimensional tolerances, visual defects, packing counts, sampling plan and report responsibilities.
Review bulk order consistency
Use the agreed process to assess finished units and investigate deviations from the reference sample.
Document acceptance before shipment
Record outcome, corrective actions where needed and approval of packing list, carton marks and transport readiness.

quality-control.checklist_title: What to Ask Before Accepting a Quality Claim
quality-control.checklist_intro: A buyer audit should ask for traceable details rather than only supplier statements such as 'certified' or 'food grade'.
checklist: Exact manufacturer/model/revision covered by the proposed declaration or report.
Component-by-component polymer composition, including cap, straw, gasket and any coatings.
Intended food-contact conditions, drink temperature, duration and age/use instructions.
Destination rules to evaluate, such as relevant U.S. FDA food-contact provisions or EU food-contact framework and plastics requirements.
Document issue date, test laboratory, tested sample identity and stated scope/limits.
Agreed lid-leak, closure/handling, dimensions and print checks for the SKU.
Accept/reject criteria and how corrective action is documented when an issue is found.
Carton count, labeling, packing protection and shipment approval responsibility.
quality-control.decision_title: A Report Is Only Useful if It Matches the Product
decision_paragraphs: FDA is a regulator, not a blanket 'FDA certification' that automatically applies to any plastic bottle. EU food-contact obligations are also specific to materials and intended use; document applicability should be assessed for the destination. Avoid marketing a bottle as BPA-free without model-appropriate substantiation.
If you need third-party inspection, agree the standard, sampling approach, measured requirements and who pays for retesting before placing the purchase order.
quality-control.faq_title: Reusable Plastic Bottle Quality & Compliance FAQs
quality-control.faq_summary: Clear answers on leaks, materials, test reports and buyer approval.
faqs: Are all XUYI plastic water bottles BPA-free?

No blanket statement can be made from a source catalog. Specify the exact model and its component polymers, then review model-appropriate material evidence and testing before publishing BPA-free claims.
Can you supply FDA or LFGB certificates?

Required evidence depends on the actual model and destination. The terms FDA and LFGB are often used loosely in marketing; ask what regulation, test method and exact component a document covers. Availability must be checked per SKU.
How should I test whether a plastic sports bottle leaks?
Agree a realistic test that defines fill level, lid assembly, orientation, duration and use conditions. A passing result for one closure does not automatically cover another lid design.
Are kids plastic water bottles inspected differently?
They may have additional considerations for child use, detachable parts, drinking straws, cleaning and applicable local requirements. The model and target age/market must be specified.
What should I check on a custom-printed water bottle?
Approve artwork size and location, actual ink or decoration on the substrate, color appearance, and agreed rub/adhesion or durability requirements.
Can third-party inspectors inspect the bulk order?
Inspection requirements can be discussed, but availability, test scope, fees, access and corrective-action responsibility must be agreed for the individual purchase order.
Does a test report cover another bottle with similar appearance?
Not automatically. Material substitutions, lid changes, colors, coatings and intended use can alter applicability; verify coverage instead of reusing a report without review.
quality-control.cta_title: Define the Quality Checks for Your Bottle Order
quality-control.cta_paragraph: Share the bottle code, target country, planned use, required documents and any leak, printing or packaging concerns. Discuss a written inspection and sample-approval scope for that project.

shipping-logistics.h1: Wholesale Plastic Water Bottle Shipping & Logistics
shipping-logistics.answer: Shipping a plastic bottle order starts with accurate packing data: units per carton, carton dimensions, gross and net weight, packaging style, model/color counts and destination. XUYI can review these details with buyers and coordinate agreed transport arrangements. Freight price, Incoterms, transit time and delivery responsibilities depend on the actual order.

shipping-logistics.intro_title: How to Prepare an Export-Ready Plastic Bottle Order
shipping-logistics.intro_summary: Large bottles often occupy more freight volume than their weight suggests, so a quote should distinguish unit price from packed-shipment cost.
intro_paragraphs: A wholesale purchase order needs more than bottle photographs. Ask for the exact SKU and color breakdown, individual package type, pieces per master carton, outer carton length, width and height, gross weight, net weight and total carton count. Large water jugs and bottles with handles may require different carton density or protective packing than compact sports bottles.

Freight options are not interchangeable. Courier/express may be considered for samples, air freight for smaller urgent orders, and sea freight for larger planned shipments. The commercially suitable option depends on packed volume, chargeable weight, destination, customs obligations and your delivery deadline.

Terms such as EXW, FOB, FCA, CIF, DAP or DDP allocate responsibilities differently. Do not assume a supplier quote includes duties, destination taxes, customs clearance or final-mile delivery unless that scope is written into the order and appropriate for the shipment. Shipment tracking and document availability are subject to the selected carrier and agreed service.
shipping-logistics.buyer_summary: Use these scenarios as starting points for a freight discussion, not guaranteed transport services.
buyer_cards: Sample or small trial order
Check courier or express suitability, dimensional weight, declared contents and duties before dispatch.
Bulk distributor order
Estimate carton volume and pallet/container requirements and plan forwarder handover accordingly.
Branded retail program
Agree packaging artwork, barcode placement, labels, inner/outer cartons and SKU segregation.
Multi-model shipment
Provide model/color quantities and carton identifiers so the packing list and goods received can be reconciled.
shipping-logistics.steps_title: From Finished Cartons to Delivery Handover
shipping-logistics.steps_summary: A clear paperwork and handover sequence helps reduce last-minute packing and freight changes.

Measure shipping volume and weight
Reconfirm outer carton dimensions, gross/net weight and total pieces against the actual pack.
Choose the shipment plan
Agree delivery destination, buyer/forwarder responsibility, transport mode and Incoterms in writing.
Prepare the document set
Reconcile commercial invoice, packing list and required product/customs documents against the contract.
Review cartons and marking
Check handling protection, carton codes, destination marks and any agreed retailer/warehouse labels.
Dispatch and share handover details
Provide agreed shipment information, carrier documents and follow-up contacts as available under the booking.

shipping-logistics.checklist_title: What International Buyers Should Include in a Shipping RFQ
shipping-logistics.checklist_intro: Accurate carton and delivery data can prevent a low unit price from producing an unexpectedly high landed cost.
checklist: Product codes, capacity variants, color breakdowns and carton quantities.
Packing type: bulk wrapping, individual retail box, custom gift pack or protective divider.
Pieces per inner pack and master carton; gross/net weight and carton dimensions.
Required product labels, barcode formats, country-of-origin text and carton marks.
Delivery country, city, port or postal code and whether a forwarder is already appointed.
Desired shipping mode, cargo-ready date and any hard receiving window.
Proposed Incoterm with named place and agreed responsibility for export/import clearance.
Commercial invoice, packing list, relevant material documents and any customer-specific warehouse requirements.
decision_paragraphs: EXW, FOB and DDP are not interchangeable quote labels. Each has different cost and risk responsibilities; the named place and applicable Incoterms edition should be written into the contract. For retail shipments, labeling and warehouse handling fees can materially affect the total.
A large-capacity plastic jug may have low unit weight but require more carton space. Ask for actual packed-volume data and compare freight based on cartons, not only nominal bottle volume.
shipping-logistics.faq_title: Plastic Water Bottle Packing & Shipping FAQs
shipping-logistics.faq_summary: What procurement teams need to know about cartons, carriers, documentation and landed cost.
faqs: Can XUYI ship plastic water bottles internationally?
International shipping arrangements can be reviewed for the destination and selected order. The route, carrier, responsible party, charges and any restrictions must be confirmed before booking.
What shipping documents should I expect?

Typically a commercial invoice and packing list are discussed, with transport documents and other declarations determined by the carrier, Incoterms, destination and product. Confirm the exact list per order.
Do you support FOB, EXW, CIF or DDP shipping terms?
Trade terms are discussed case by case; listing a term is not a promise it is offered. Confirm the Incoterm, named place, duties, clearance and delivery scope in the quotation.
How do I calculate freight for a bulky plastic water jug?
You need packed carton measurements, gross weight, total cartons, and the freight mode. Carriers may use chargeable or volumetric weight, so the bottle's empty weight alone is insufficient.
Can bottles be packed in custom retail boxes?
Packaging options depend on the actual SKU, required artwork, quantity and sourcing feasibility. Send dielines, barcodes and shelf/warehouse requirements for review.
Can I combine kids bottles, sports bottles and shakers in one shipment?
A combined order may be discussed, but model/color quantities, production readiness, customs classification, packing and shipping costs need separate confirmation.
How long does shipping take to the US or EU?

There is no universal verified shipping duration. Timing varies by destination, mode, season, carrier schedules and customs processing. Request a route-specific estimate after carton details are confirmed.
shipping-logistics.cta_title: Request a Packing and Freight Planning Discussion
shipping-logistics.cta_paragraph: Send your model quantities, destination, desired packing and preferred handover terms. Actual carton measurements and freight arrangements should be confirmed before final commercial commitment.
